objective: A calm, guided SportsPulse workspace that PPHL operators can use without reconstructing the module structure.
designSystem: Keep existing SportsPulse themes, type, tokens and shared components. The guided UI contract takes precedence over older decorative layout examples.
deliveryRule: One complete user job per pilot. Validate behavior and visual hierarchy before expanding across roles.

firstPilot.name: Find the right season and game
firstPilot.status: Deployed to all six staging projects at 0d459692; deployed browser checks passed; PPHL usability acceptance pending
changes: Explicit league-and-season search instead of three competing workspaces.
One selected season and main action; other season tasks open on demand.
Choice preserved in the URL through refresh, pagination and Back.
Games open within the selected season and lead to the existing read-only game view.
Regular-season games return to the chosen season instead of Playoffs.
Game date and venue stay visible without opening help.
Failed reads appear unavailable instead of pretending the organization has no seasons.
Decorative ambient wave removed from the organization console; navigation progress retained.

verification.environment: Local frontend with staging authentication and a read-only staging API proxy
verification.pphlUsabilityAcceptance: Not performed; no training-free usability claim yet

nextSprints.scope: Short groups for basics, dates, divisions, registration and review. Advanced rules open only when needed; draft recovery and required fields remain intact.
Choose source, inspect what will copy, adjust dates, review differences and save a draft. Rehearse 70-league operations separately.

nextSprints.job: Register and approve a team or player
nextSprints.scope: Clear fee/waiver state, returning-account recovery, staff review and visible destination on the player/captain side.
Ice availability, draft generation, conflict review and explicit publication, with receiving captain/player verification.
Discover the assigned game, enter events, finalize and inspect the resulting score, statistics and standings. Make the handoff between staff roles explicit.
Captain invitation or roster change, approval when needed, and a clear receiving-player destination.
One task at a time: attendance, membership proof or waiver. Show exactly what is required, who reviews it and what happens next.
Choose the intended audience, preview the message, send and inspect delivery and the recipient inbox.

acceptanceForEverySprint: The operator can identify the current organization, league/season and purpose.
One visually dominant next action; necessary alternative actions remain discoverable.
Required business information is retained; advanced configuration is disclosed on demand.
Save, submit and publish describe their real effect and lead to the correct destination.
Loading, empty, error and success states are truthful and recoverable.
Actual role and receiving-surface tests pass, including negative access checks.
Light/dark, keyboard and phone layouts are verified.
A PPHL operator attempts the job without live instructions; record hesitation, wrong turns, completion and assistance. Do not infer usability acceptance from CI.
constraints: No production or PPHL client-data changes in this pilot
Parent/public spectator scope needs agreement before those role experiences are redesigned

secondPilot.name: Create a season
secondPilot.status: Implemented; local browser journey, production frontend build and shared/console typechecks passed. Staging validation pending.
changes: Single-organization operators start with league basics; super admin retains explicit organization selection.
Three small date panels with persisted progress and full validation at save.
One expanded division at a time; detailed game, standings and playoff rules open on demand.
Full rule summary available during final review; draft and explicit publication preserved.
Keyboard focus follows each question; current theme and business values retained.
constraints: Engineering staging fixtures only; clean client testing data unchanged
